label: Bright Data
description: Search, Crawl and Scrape any site, at scale, without getting blocked

tools.name: ExtractWebPageFields
tools.description:
Extract structured data from various websites like LinkedIn, Amazon, Instagram, etc.
NEVER MAKE UP LINKS. IF LINKS ARE NEEDED, FIND THEM WITH A WEB SEARCH FIRST.
Supported source types:
- amazon_product, amazon_product_reviews
- linkedin_person_profile, linkedin_company_profile
- zoominfo_company_profile
- instagram_profiles, instagram_posts, instagram_reels, instagram_comments
- facebook_posts, facebook_marketplace_listings, facebook_company_reviews
- x_posts
- zillow_properties_listing
- booking_hotel_listings
- youtube_videos

Examples:
    extract_web_page_fields("amazon_product", "https://amazon.com/dp/B08N5WRWNW")
        -> {"source_type": "amazon_product", "url": "...", "records": [{"title": ...}]}
    extract_web_page_fields(
        "facebook_company_reviews", "https://facebook.com/company", num_of_reviews=50
    ) -> {"source_type": "facebook_company_reviews", "url": "...", "records": [...]}

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: URL of the web resource to extract data from

parameters.name: num_of_reviews
parameters.description: Number of reviews to retrieve. Only applicable for facebook_company_reviews. Defaults to the Bright Data default number of reviews.

parameters.name: timeout
parameters.description: Maximum time in seconds to wait for data retrieval, at most 50. Defaults to 50.

parameters.name: polling_interval
parameters.description: Time in seconds between polling attempts. Defaults to 1.

output.description: Structured records from the requested source

tools.name: GetWebPage
tools.description:
Scrape a webpage and return content in Markdown format using Bright Data.

    Examples:
        get_web_page("https://example.com")
            -> {"url": "https://example.com", "markdown": "# Example Page

Content..."}

output.description: The web page's content as Markdown

tools.name: SearchWebPages
tools.description:
Search using Google, Bing, or Yandex with advanced parameters using Bright Data.

    Examples:
        search_web_pages("climate change")
            -> {"query": "climate change", "content": "# Search Results

## Climate..."}
        search_web_pages("Python tutorials", engine="bing", num_results=5)
        search_web_pages("cats", search_type="images", country_code="us")

parameters.name: engine
parameters.description: Search engine to use. Defaults to google.

parameters.name: language
parameters.description: Two-letter language code. Defaults to no language preference.

parameters.name: country_code
parameters.description: Two-letter country code. Defaults to no country preference.

parameters.name: search_type
parameters.description: Type of search. Defaults to a regular web search.

parameters.name: start
parameters.description: Results pagination offset. Defaults to the first page.

parameters.name: num_results
parameters.description: Number of results to return. Defaults to 10.

parameters.name: location
parameters.description: Location for search results. Defaults to no location preference.

parameters.name: device
parameters.description: Device type. Defaults to a desktop device.

parameters.name: return_json
parameters.description: Return JSON instead of Markdown. Defaults to False.

output.description: The search results page as Markdown or JSON

## Secrets

This tool requires the following secrets:

- `BRIGHTDATA_API_KEY`
- `BRIGHTDATA_ZONE`

### Auth

The Arcade Bright Data MCP Server uses [Bright Data](https://brightdata.com/) to access proxy networks and web scraping infrastructure.

**Global Environment Variables:**

- `BRIGHTDATA_API_KEY`: Your Bright Data API key. You can generate this from your [Bright Data dashboard](https://brightdata.com/cp/zones) under Account Settings → API Access.

- `BRIGHTDATA_ZONE`: Your Bright Data zone name (e.g., `residential_proxy1`). This is the zone identifier you created in your Bright Data dashboard under Proxies & Scraping Infrastructure → Zones.

**How to get your credentials:**

1. **API Key**: Navigate to your [Bright Data Control Panel](https://brightdata.com/cp) → Settings → API Access → Generate API Token
2. **Zone**: Go to Zones section in your dashboard, find your zone name in the format shown in the zone username: `brd-customer-{customer_id}-zone-{zone_name}`

For more details, see the [Bright Data API Documentation](https://docs.brightdata.com/api-reference).

summary:
Arcade's Bright Data toolkit enables web search, full-page scraping, and structured data extraction at scale across major platforms, without bot-blocking interference.

## Capabilities

- **Structured extraction from major platforms**: Pull typed records from Amazon (products, reviews), LinkedIn (people, companies), Instagram (profiles, posts, reels, comments), Facebook (posts, marketplace listings, company reviews), X (posts), ZoomInfo (company profiles), Zillow (property listings), Booking.com (hotel listings), and YouTube (videos).
- **General-purpose web scraping**: Fetch any public webpage and receive its content rendered as Markdown for downstream processing.
- **Multi-engine web search**: Query Google, Bing, or Yandex with control over result count, search type (e.g., images), and country targeting.

## Secrets

This toolkit requires two secrets configured in your Arcade environment.

- **`BRIGHTDATA_API_KEY`**: Your Bright Data account API key. Obtain it from the Bright Data dashboard under **Account Settings → API Tokens**. The key authenticates all requests to Bright Data's APIs. See [Bright Data API documentation](https://docs.brightdata.com/api-reference/introduction) for details.

- **`BRIGHTDATA_ZONE`**: The name of a Bright Data [zone](https://docs.brightdata.com/scraping-infrastructure/web-data-platform/zones/overview) (a proxy/scraping configuration) associated with your account. Zones define the scraping infrastructure (e.g., residential proxies, datacenter proxies) used for requests. Create and name a zone in the Bright Data control panel under **Proxies & Scraping Infrastructure**, then provide that zone name here.

Configure secrets at [https://docs.arcade.dev/en/guides/create-tools/tool-basics/create-tool-secrets](https://docs.arcade.dev/en/guides/create-tools/tool-basics/create-tool-secrets) or via the Arcade dashboard at [https://api.arcade.dev/dashboard/auth/secrets](https://api.arcade.dev/dashboard/auth/secrets).
